methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified roster of 12 external HDD models (portable and desktop) across Seagate, WD, Toshiba, and LaCie. Re-checked against manufacturer pages (Seagate.com, WesternDigital.com, storage.toshiba.com), major retailers (Best Buy, Staples, Newegg, Walmart, B&H Photo, CDW, Dell), and WD's encryption compatibility matrix. Key correction theme: Seagate One Touch ships in two distinct lines — standard 'One Touch HDD' (STKC/STKB suffix, NO hardware encryption) and 'One Touch with Password' (STKZ/STKY suffix, AES-256). The draft conflated them; encryption is now false for the standard STKC/STKB models that are actually named. RPM is set null for portable One Touch and desktop Expansion/Elements/easystore enclosures because the manufacturer does not publicly disclose RPM for those retail enclosures (a null beats a 5400/7200 guess). capacity_tb and rpm are unitless numbers; dimensions_in is a string with units; boolean fields reflect confirmed yes/no as sourced. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.provenance: CORRECTED. hardware_encryption true->false: STKC5000400 is the standard One Touch HDD with no hardware encryption; only the 'One Touch with Password' STKZ5000400 (separate Best Buy SKU) carries AES-256. priceUsd 199.99->154.99: $199.99 was the STKZ password variant; the named STKC model is ~$155 at Walmart. rpm 5400->null: Seagate does not publish RPM for the One Touch portable enclosure. Interface USB 3.2 Gen 1 confirmed via Dell listing. Dimensions retained per Staples/retail listings.
